name: Explore Abdi fatah farah’s portfolio and open a project conversation
description: Verifies the requested portfolio name, email, WhatsApp number, and project details.
steps: Confirm the displayed name is Abdi fatah farah
Inspect the WhatsApp contact link and select Explore my work
expected: The site shows the requested name and email, the WhatsApp link uses +252612722002, and the project showcase is reachable.

name: Use navigation and theme controls on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile menu and theme switch remain usable on a narrow viewport.
steps: Open the portfolio on a mobile viewport
expected: About is reachable, the menu closes after selection, and the light theme is applied.

name: Prepare a WhatsApp message from the contact form
description: Verifies a valid contact message is prepared for WhatsApp and empty input is blocked.
steps: Enter a name, valid email, and message
expected: Empty required fields are blocked; a completed message opens in WhatsApp for review before the visitor sends it.

name: Browse the supplied photo gallery
description: Verifies the photos from the supplied portfolio folder and the existing project timeline remain present.
expected: The project timeline and all five photos supplied inside abdifitahporf2026 are represented in the gallery.
